steps.C1_tick: every lifecycle job EXCEPT SNAPSHOT (lifecycle.run_now(job) per job, in registry order) until nothing new: SETTLE_DUE (as-of rows settle with business_date = due date, plan C15: CDX initial payments due 2026-10-22, option premiums due 2026-10-23); ACCRUE_DAILY for the new contracts (TRS and IRS nights from the start date; a CDX keeps the state swaps_cds.book seeds - the rebate covers 2026-09-21 .. the trade date - so its first new night is 2026-10-22; night D posts with business date D+1; plan C10); SWAP_VM per contract and date in date order with that date's inputs (TRS recorded CLOSE, CDX proxy of the date + basis, UST_PAR curve of the date via CurveStore.for_date; weekends NO_CHANGE; plan C10 / C12); OPTION_MARGIN_MARK (reservation 0: the 700P covers the 675P). SNAPSHOT is held back so no snapshot is written before C2-C4 have posted
steps.C2_asof_sweep: cash.asof_sweep (plan C15) per business date 2026-10-21 .. L, ascending, for the accounts the import credited: per account and date the sweep is min(excess, import cash), excess = settled - restricted as of that date (net CSA collateral received + 2520, C21 as_of) - payables - buffer at the close of that date, import cash = the account's settled cash created by the import's groups (their 1010 lines with business_date <= that date) less earlier as-of sweeps -> SWEEP_OUT to Treasury dated that date; restricted collateral is never swept and the owner's pre-import idle cash is never swept on a past date (US Exchange's +509,392.94 pre-import excess at the close of 2026-10-22 stays; its import cash is negative: premiums paid). View 2026-10-27: F1:PB_GS on 2026-10-22 about 596,223.95 (settled 786,553.40 - restricted 180,329.45 - buffer 10,000.00); later dates about 0 (VM flows move settled and restricted together). Request ids impcu:IMP-F1-20261027-A:C2:<account>:<date>
steps.C3_business_date_cash: every F1 account's settled cash at the close of every date 2026-10-21 .. the day before the apply must be >= 0, and every current balance >= 0 (L18 at each commit). Before C2, F1:TREASURY closes 2026-10-22 at about -234,337.70 (1,467,580.80 - 1,701,918.50 of as-of IM and day-0 VM dated 2026-10-21); after C2 about +361,886.25. Any remaining business-date negative -> cash.asof_transfer (plan C15: transfers.kind TRANSFER, linked_type 'asof_funding', linked_id = the line key, journal entry kind ASOF_FUNDING, memo 'as-of funding') from the book account with the most idle business-date cash that date and back on the first later date it is needed; none possible -> refuse. A current-balance shortfall (cash spent since) refuses with the amount to move into Treasury first (an ordinary transfer), then the dry run is re-run. Request ids impcu:IMP-F1-20261027-A:C3:<from>:<to>:<date>
steps.C4_reaccrue: cash.reaccrue (plan C17) for kinds cashint / pbcredit / pb on every F1 account whose business-date balance changed (F1:TREASURY, F1:PB_GS), nights 2026-10-21 .. each account's last accrued night when C4 runs (accrual_state.accrued_through; it also corrects a night first accrued inside C1 before the C2 sweeps): each night keeps its original rate, only the base changes; the restated amounts follow accrue_segment's cumulative rounding (a segment = consecutive nights with the same base and rate, cumulative = round half-even(base x rate x n / 360)); pbcredit base = max(0, settled - restricted as of that night); correction business_date = D+1 (the day a night's accrual posts); idem reaccrue:IMP-F1-20261027-A:<account>:<kind>:<night>; request ids impcu:IMP-F1-20261027-A:C4:<account>:<kind>. View 2026-10-27: Treasury about -848.07 through night 2026-10-26 (-263.60 through 10-22, -701.52 through 10-25), PB credit about +4.38 (+0.87 through 10-22, +3.50 through 10-25)
steps.C5_restate: nav.restate (plan C9d) of every F1 nav_snapshots row recorded before the first write: every account row and F1:ALL, 2026-10-21 .. the last snapshot date before the apply day (non-business days after L at L's marks), plus a version row with original_nav_c 0 where an account with no original row has restated figures that are not 0 (F1:PB_GS on 2026-10-21); groups = one per import line + 'funding' (the C2 as-of sweeps and C3 transfers); every import-created entry belongs to exactly one group or to the interest effect; split per row: original NAV, import effect by group, interest restatement, mark-policy effect by position, dating line for a late snapshot, residual 0 for every account and for F1:ALL; idempotent (a date whose latest version of this batch has the same figures gets no new version); nav_snapshots never replaced.
